name: Aircraft: the whole flight-dynamics study
description: Every study of examples/flight_dynamics on one canvas: verification, trim and stability, take-off with crosswind and gust cases, severe turbulence for the four aircraft, Pratt, the same-gust comparison, three.js viewers and Blender Cycles clips, each number checked against the committed results.

params.tolerance_source: deterministic simulation: the same library code and inputs; 1e-6 relative covers BLAS / platform rounding; stochastic turbulence fields: the tolerance of each mean is the spread over the three seeds that results/turbulence.json reports for it
